results.explanation: Source-visible behavior at the declared entry is deny. DocumentViewSet.download delegates to file_response, which resolves the requested document and its root, then applies the decisive owner-aware view_document check to root_doc—not to the caller-owned version. The check permits the root owner or an object permission; under the supplied premise the caller is neither the root owner nor granted object view access, so file_response returns HttpResponseForbidden before serving a file. The caller's global view permission and ownership of the selected version do not replace this root-object check in the supplied path. If authorization had passed, the protected effect would serve file_doc: _get_effective_file_doc selects the requested version itself when it is a version and no explicit version parameter is present; otherwise it resolves the selected file document from the root and request. In either case, the file is served only after the root check. This is source-supported for the supplied scenario and fixed source crop only; source discovery remains not-tested, so no repository-wide completeness claim is made.

entry.statement: DocumentViewSet.download delegates the download request to file_response with attachment disposition.

binding.statement: The handler loads request_doc by the requested primary key and derives root_doc from that request document before authorization.

After authorization, effective file selection returns the requested version when it is a version without an explicit version parameter; otherwise it resolves a file document from the root and request.

control.statement: The decisive authorization control invokes has_perms_owner_aware for view_document on root_doc and returns HttpResponseForbidden when that check fails.
The owner-aware check allows an unowned object, its owner, or a user for whom the object-permission checker reports the requested permission.

citations.quote:
def has_perms_owner_aware(user, perms, obj):
    """
    Legacy slow path (guardian-backed) single-object permission check.

    The queryset-filtering side of this migrated onto
    ``PermittedObjectsFilter``/``permitted_object_ids()``, but this
    single-object check still has many production callers. Several callers
    remain across ``documents/``, ``paperless_mail/``, and ``paperless_ai/``
    -- grep for this function name before removing it.
    """
    checker = ObjectPermissionChecker(user)
    return obj.owner is None or obj.owner == user or checker.has_perm(perms, obj)

effect.statement: The selected file_doc is passed to serve_file with attachment disposition, which is the protected download effect.
